title: Differentiated Aggregation to Improve Generalization in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2404.11754v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper focuses on reducing the communication cost of federated learning by exploring generalization bounds and representation learning. We first characterize a tighter generalization bound for one-round federated learning based on local clients' generalizations and heterogeneity of data distribution (non-iid scenario). We also characterize a generalization bound in R-round federated learning and its relation to the number of local updates (local stochastic gradient descents (SGDs)). Then, based on our generalization bound analysis and its interpretation through representation learning, we infer that less frequent aggregations for the representation extractor (typically corresponds to initial layers) compared to the head (usually the final layers) leads to the creation of more generalizable models, particularly in non-iid scenarios. translated_title: 差异化聚合以提升联邦学习中的泛化能力
translated_abstract: 本文通过探索泛化界限和表示学习，聚焦于降低联邦学习的通信成本。我们首先基于本地客户端的泛化能力和数据分布的异质性（非独立同分布场景），刻画了一轮联邦学习的更紧泛化界限。我们还刻画了R轮联邦学习中的泛化界限及其与本地更新次数（本地随机梯度下降）的关系。然后，基于我们的泛化界限分析及其通过表示学习的解释，我们推断出，与头部（通常是最终层）相比，对表示提取器（通常对应初始层）进行较少频率的聚合，特别是在非独立同分布场景下，有助于生成更具泛化能力的模型。我们基于上述见解设计了一种新颖的自适应本地步数联邦学习（FedALS）算法。
tldr: 本文提出FedALS算法，通过差异化聚合频率（减少表示提取器的聚合次数），在非独立同分布场景下提升联邦学习模型的泛化能力并降低通信成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the FedALS algorithm, which improves model generalization in non-iid federated learning by reducing aggregation frequency for representation extractors, thereby lowering communication costs.
